name: Pediatric classic Hodgkin lymphoma: response-adapted ABVE-PC (AHOD0031); OEPA-COPDAC alternative

biomarkers.note: Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma v1.2026. Pediatric classic Hodgkin lymphoma therapy is response-adapted (interim FDG-PET Deauville response after 2 cycles), not biomarker-gated; no per-drug dose here is gated by a molecular biomarker (ped_hodgkin.txt lines 244, 650 to 656).

treatmentSetting: primary systemic therapy, response-adapted (interim FDG-PET after 2 cycles drives cycle number and involved-site radiotherapy)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: interim response after 2 cycles (adequate versus inadequate, FDG-PET Deauville) determines number of ABVE-PC cycles and involved-site radiotherapy
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma v1.2026
eligibilityCriteria.locator: ped_hodgkin.txt lines 244 (Deauville 5-point scale), 650 to 656 (ABVE-PC adequate/inadequate response), 854 to 861

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: PFTs before bleomycin; FEV1/FVC >60% generally acceptable for bleomycin use
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma v1.2026
eligibilityCriteria.locator: ped_hodgkin.txt lines 397 to 399 and 471 (PFTs if bleomycin indicated; FEV1/FVC >60%)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: OEPA-COPDAC (GPOH-HD-2002 / EuroNet-PHL-C1) is an alternative response-adapted regimen; COPDAC repeated every 28 days for 2 cycles for intermediate stages or 4 cycles for advanced stages
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma v1.2026

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.locator: ped_hodgkin.txt line 1853 (ABVE-PC AHOD0031: Doxorubicin 25 mg/m2 IV Days 1 and 2); dexrazoxane/cumulative-doxorubicin guidance lines 320 to 322

drugs.notes: ABVE-PC 'A'. Printed dose 25 mg/m2 IV Days 1 and 2 (ped_hodgkin.txt line 1853). ISMP tall-man DOXOrubicin. Strongly consider dexrazoxane for children/adolescents expected to receive >=250 mg/m2 cumulative doxorubicin-equivalent (line 322), carried as the warn threshold; 350 mg/m2 is the conservative pediatric hard ceiling (below the adult 550; dexrazoxane per COG), matching the pediatric guard used in ped-neuroblastoma.

drugs.name: Bleomycin (Day 1)

provenance.locator: ped_hodgkin.txt line 1854 (ABVE-PC AHOD0031: Bleomycin 5 U/m2 IV Day 1, 10 U/m2 IV Day 8)

drugs.notes: ABVE-PC 'B', Day 1 dose. Printed as 5 U/m2 IV on Day 1 (ped_hodgkin.txt line 1854); the Day 8 dose escalates to 10 U/m2 and is encoded as a separate Bleomycin (Day 8) entry so both days compute correctly. PULMONARY toxicity risk: obtain PFTs before use (FEV1/FVC >60% generally acceptable, line 471); monitor for pneumonitis and hold for pulmonary toxicity.

drugs.name: Bleomycin (Day 8)

provenance.locator: ped_hodgkin.txt line 1854 (ABVE-PC AHOD0031: Bleomycin 5 U/m2 IV Day 1, 10 U/m2 IV Day 8)

drugs.notes: ABVE-PC 'B', Day 8 dose. Printed as 10 U/m2 IV on Day 8 (ped_hodgkin.txt line 1854); split from the Day 1 (5 U/m2) entry so the Day 8 escalation is computed rather than left in prose. PULMONARY toxicity risk: obtain PFTs before use (FEV1/FVC >60% generally acceptable, line 471); monitor for pneumonitis and hold for pulmonary toxicity.

drugs.name: vinCRIStine

provenance.locator: ped_hodgkin.txt line 1855 (ABVE-PC AHOD0031: Vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 IV Days 1 and 8; 2.8 mg/dose maximum per dose)

The source prints a 2.8 mg/dose pediatric maximum, but StewardMD carries the ISMP 2 mg per-dose cap as the safety default (see evidence.divergence). ISMP tall-man vinCRIStine; IV only and fatal if given intrathecally.

provenance.locator: ped_hodgkin.txt line 1859 (ABVE-PC AHOD0031: Cyclophosphamide 800 mg/m2 IV Day 1)

supportiveCare: bleomycin PULMONARY toxicity: PFTs before use (FEV1/FVC >60% generally acceptable), monitor for pneumonitis, hold for pulmonary toxicity (ped_hodgkin.txt lines 397 to 399, 471)
anthracycline cardioprotection: strongly consider dexrazoxane for children/adolescents expected to receive >=250 mg/m2 cumulative doxorubicin-equivalent (ped_hodgkin.txt lines 320 to 322)
response-adapted: interim FDG-PET Deauville after 2 cycles determines cycle number and involved-site radiotherapy (ped_hodgkin.txt lines 244, 650 to 656)

alternative regimen OEPA-COPDAC (GPOH-HD-2002 / EuroNet-PHL-C1): OEPA = Vincristine 1.5 mg/m2 Days 1/8/15 (2 mg/dose max), Etoposide 125 mg/m2 Days 1 to 5, Prednisone 60 mg/m2 Days 1 to 15, Doxorubicin 40 mg/m2 Days 1 and 15, every 28 days x2; COPDAC = Cyclophosphamide 500 mg/m2 Days 1 and 8, Vincristine 1.5 mg/m2 Days 1 and 8 (2 mg/dose max), Prednisone 40 mg/m2 Days 1 to 15 (80 mg/day max), Dacarbazine 250 mg/m2 Days 1 to 3, every 28 days x2 or x4 by stage (ped_hodgkin.txt lines 1901 to 1928)
antiemetic and growth-factor support per NCCN tiers

monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle
pulmonary function tests before bleomycin and if pulmonary symptoms develop
cardiac assessment and cumulative doxorubicin-equivalent tracking
interim and end-of-therapy FDG-PET/CT (Deauville) for response adaptation
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each vincristine dose

doseModificationRules.text: Hold bleomycin for pulmonary toxicity; physician decides on discontinuation.

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC < 1000 or platelets < 100k at cycle start
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. AHOD0031 count-recovery criteria apply; physician decides.

divergence.note: The pediatric ABVE-PC source prints a 2.8 mg/dose vincristine maximum, higher than the ISMP 2 mg per-dose cap StewardMD applies by default. The 2 mg cap is carried for safety; the printed 2.8 mg pediatric maximum is surfaced for clinical review rather than silently overriding either value.

provenanceNote: PEDIATRIC. StewardMD draft for pediatric classic Hodgkin lymphoma. The primary regimen ABVE-PC (AHOD0031) per-drug doses ARE printed in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma v1.2026 and are used verbatim as sourced with locators: Doxorubicin 25 mg/m2 Days 1 and 2 (ped_hodgkin.txt line 1853), Bleomycin 5 U/m2 Day 1 and 10 U/m2 Day 8 (line 1854), Vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 Days 1 and 8 (line 1855), Etoposide 125 mg/m2 Days 1 to 3 (line 1856), Prednisone 40 mg/m2/day BID Days 1 to 7 (line 1858), Cyclophosphamide 800 mg/m2 Day 1 (line 1859), every 21 days for 4 cycles (line 1860, cycle number response-adapted). The OEPA-COPDAC alternative (GPOH-HD-2002 / EuroNet-PHL-C1) printed doses are recorded in supportiveCare with locators (lines 1901 to 1928). No pediatric dose was invented; no field is VERIFY. Two named safety rules are enforced: bleomycin pulmonary surveillance with a PFT gate (FEV1/FVC >60%), and the ISMP vinCRIStine 2 mg per-dose cap, which is LOWER than the printed 2.8 mg pediatric maximum and is recorded as an evidence.divergence for clinical review rather than silently overriding the source. Anthracycline cumulative tracking with a >=250 mg/m2 doxorubicin-equivalent dexrazoxane threshold is included; vinCRIStine is IV only and never intrathecal. NCCN per-disease template alignment, StewardMD clinical (R1) review, and any hospital-implementation overlay approval are pending. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
